rules.sql: WITH pairs(client, product, outcome) AS (VALUES ('ACL','CM S','FAIL'), ('ACM','CM CRD','FAIL'), ('ACM','CM CT','FAIL'), ('ACM','CM S','OK'), ('ADP','CM KC','FAIL'), ('ALG','CM CT','FAIL'), ('ALV','CM SB','FAIL'), ('AMC','CM CT','FAIL'), ('AQC','CM CT','OK'), ('ASI','CM CT','FAIL'), ('ASI','CM DF','FAIL'), ('AST','CM C','OK'), ('AST','CM S','OK'), ('AST','CM SM','OK'), ('AST','CM W','OK'), ('AXI','CM KW','OK'), ('BEG','CM CT','OK'), ('BFA','CM CT','FAIL'), ('BFE','CM CT','OK'), ('BFL','CM BO','OK'), ('BFL','CM SM','FAIL'), ('BKP','CM C','FAIL'), ('BOC','CM SM','FAIL'), ('BOV','CM C','FAIL'), ('BOV','CM W','OK'), ('BSB','CM BO','FAIL'), ('BSB','CM SM','FAIL'), ('BUN','CM KW','OK'), ('CAD','CM C','OK'), ('CAD','CM KW','OK'), ('CAD','CM W','OK'), ('CAP','CM CT','OK'), ('CBE','CM CT','OK'), ('CDL','CM CT','OK'), ('CFC','CM CT','OK'), ('CFF','CM CT','OK'), ('CGE','CM S','OK'), ('CGL','CM CT','OK'), ('CPB','CM CT','FAIL'), ('CTL','CM CT','FAIL'), ('CTS','CM CT','OK'), ('CWE','CM CT','OK'), ('DAI','CM S','OK'), ('DFE','CM CT','OK'), ('DFS','CM QC','FAIL'), ('DYE','CM CT','OK'), ('EDF','CM CT','OK'), ('FAB','CM BO','OK'), ('FAB','CM C','OK'), ('FAB','CM S','FAIL'), ('FMP','CM CRD','OK'), ('FMP','CM CT','FAIL'), ('FMP','CM S','FAIL'), ('FSI','CM C','OK'), ('FSI','CM CRD','FAIL'), ('FSI','CM SM','OK'), ('GAE','CM CT','OK'), ('GCB','CM CC','OK'), ('GCB','CM QC','OK'), ('GIL','CM CT','FAIL'), ('HSD','CM C','FAIL'), ('HSD','CM SM','OK'), ('IOL','CM BO','FAIL'), ('IOL','CM RS','FAIL'), ('IVO','CM SM','FAIL'), ('JGE','CM CT','OK'), ('JMU','CM CT','OK'), ('JMU','CM S','OK'), ('JUP','CM C','OK'), ('JUP','CM IJ','OK'), ('JUP','CM KW','OK'), ('JUP','CM SM','OK'), ('JUP','CM W','OK'), ('KMI','CM CT','FAIL'), ('KTE','CM S','FAIL'), ('LCE','CM CT','OK'), ('LIB','CM CT','FAIL'), ('LIT','CM CT','FAIL'), ('LMB','CM S','FAIL'), ('MAE','CM S','OK'), ('MAN','CM CT','OK'), ('MAO','CM W','FAIL'), ('MDA','CM QC','FAIL'), ('MDL','CM CC','OK'), ('MFE','CM CT','OK'), ('MLK','CM C','FAIL'), ('MLK','CM S','FAIL'), ('MLK','CM SM','FAIL'), ('MLK','CM W','FAIL'), ('MOA','CM IJ','OK'), ('MOA','CM S','OK'), ('MOA','CM W','OK'), ('MSF','CM SB','OK'), ('NFO','CM C','OK'), ('NFO','CM SM','OK'), ('OCC','CM CC','OK'), ('OGM','CM MW','OK'), ('OMF','CM KC','FAIL'), ('ORM','CM C','FAIL'), ('ORM','CM MW','FAIL'), ('PBE','CM CT','OK'), ('PGE','CM S','OK'), ('RCC','CM QC','OK'), ('RWF','CM CT','OK'), ('SCE','CM CT','FAIL'), ('SCF','CM CT','OK'), ('SCW','CM CT','FAIL'), ('SEC','CM CT','FAIL'), ('SIC','CM S','FAIL'), ('SIP','CM OR EUR','FAIL'), ('SLC','CM CT','FAIL'), ('SLC','CM S','FAIL'), ('SMH','CM OR','FAIL'), ('SMT','CM CT','FAIL'), ('SND','CM IJ','OK'), ('SND','CM QW','OK'), ('SND','CM SB','OK'), ('SSO','CM BO','OK'), ('TAE','CM S','FAIL'), ('TER','CM SB','FAIL'), ('TFC','CM S','FAIL'), ('TMB','CM CT','OK'), ('TSR','CM CT','OK'), ('TVE','CM S','FAIL'), ('UDA','CM C','FAIL'), ('UNF','CM KO','FAIL'), ('VBN','CM S','OK'), ('VCI','CM OR','FAIL'), ('VZN','CM S','FAIL'), ('WSF','CM CT','OK')), vd AS (SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.client, p.product, p.outcome, c.contract_month, c.tenant_id, c.business_unit, c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c JOIN pairs p ON upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = upper(p.client) AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = upper(trim(p.product)) WHERE c.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM vd) AND upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu), flags AS ( SELECT s.client, s.product, s.outcome, s.contract_month, s.security_id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table dt, vd WHERE dt.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND dt.security_id = s.security_id AND dt.business_unit = vd.business_unit AND dt.is_latest_version = 1 AND dt.transaction_date < vd.value_date) AS f_deal, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table dt, vd WHERE dt.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND dt.security_id = s.security_id AND dt.business_unit = vd.business_unit AND dt.is_latest_version = 1 AND dt.transaction_date < vd.value_date AND (lower(dt.business_unit) <> all (array['alm','bkr','ebo','gpc','oad','odr','og2','ogp','spc','stg','tsy','usg']) OR lower(dt.subportfolio) NOT LIKE 'conso%') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.premium_fy_table p JOIN opera.valuation_date_table pv ON pv.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND pv.business_unit = p.business_unit JOIN opera.financial_year_table fy ON fy.tenant_id = pv.tenant_id AND fy.financial_year = p.financial_year AND fy.start_date <= pv.settlement_date AND fy.end_date >= pv.settlement_date WHERE p.tenant_id = dt.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = dt.business_unit AND p.trade_id = dt.trade_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a JOIN opera.valuation_date_table av ON av.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND av.business_unit = a.business_unit WHERE a.tenant_id = dt.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = dt.business_unit AND a.trade_id = dt.trade_id AND a.value_date <= av.value_date)) AS f_elig, m.security_id IS NOT NULL AS f_master, coalesce(m.status = 'Active', false) AS f_active, m.vol1_id IS NOT NULL AS f_vol1, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv, vd WHERE sv.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND sv.vol_id = m.vol1_id AND sv.value_date = vd.value_date) AS f_surface FROM sec s LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table m ON m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.business_unit = s.business_unit AND m.security_id = s.security_id) SELECT client, product, outcome, contract_month, COUNT(*) AS s1_cache, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f_deal) AS s2_deal, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f_deal AND f_elig) AS s3_eligible, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f_deal AND f_elig AND f_master) AS s4_master, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f_deal AND f_elig AND f_master AND f_active) AS s5_active, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f_deal AND f_elig AND f_master AND f_active AND f_vol1) AS s6_vol1, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f_deal AND f_elig AND f_master AND f_active AND f_vol1 AND f_surface) AS s7_surface FROM flags GROUP BY client, product, outcome, contract_month ORDER BY outcome DESC, client, product, contract_month
